name: secret-shield
description: Swaps passwords, keys and database URLs in your messages for named placeholders before Claude sees them and stores the values outside your projects. Showing a value on hover is opt-in.

revealOnHover.title: Reveal secrets on hover
revealOnHover.description: Show a hidden secret's real value when you hover its placeholder in the expanded view (ctrl+o). Off keeps values out of the screen entirely.
